description: Source code for a tool that reads zlib compressed calibration data from AVM Fritz!Box devices, including functions for decompressing data and handling zlib errors.

methods.name: inf
methods.description: Decompresses data from source file to destination file using zlib inflate, with limit and skip parameters.

methods.name: zerr
methods.description: Reports zlib or I/O errors based on return code.

methods.name: get_num
methods.description: Parses a string as a number, supporting hexadecimal and decimal formats.
